newsitem.title: USA: US Mint buys 1.3 mln kgs copper at avg. $2.3407/kg.
newsitem.headline: US Mint buys 1.3 mln kgs copper at avg. $2.3407/kg.

text.p: The U.S. Mint said Tuesday that it bought 1,300,000 kgs of copper at an average $2.3407 per kg from three firms.
Copper will be used in coinage.
--Gerald Metals, Stamford, Connecticut, 622,000 kgs for $2.3160 per kg.

--Kataman Metals Inc, 510,000 kgs at an average $2.3623 per kg; including 454,000 kgs for $2.3635 per kg, 18,144 kgs for $2.3524 per kg, 19,856 kgs for $2.3524 per kg and 18,000 kgs for $2.3524 per kg.
